limitations: Finite observed progress, not universal/infinite-stall freedom or an architectural timeout constant.

Python/socket client timings include software scheduling; DPDK four-worker tail measurement remains separate.
Second boot recording contains an intentional freeze/resume gap outside the analyzed measurement range.
System-interface read intervals exclude CPU-side issue/completion and the static-link tail; boundary-incomplete pairs are excluded.
